findings.problem: Pinned tokenizer exposes PostgreSQL comment/continued-escape-string text as real placeholders; numeric dollar tags and Unicode ordinal junk also falsely pass.
findings.resolution: Conservative bounded token preflight refuses these forms, rejects unsupported Unicode dollar tags/Unicode string literals, preserves positive ordinary-token cases.

other_reviewed_scopes: No additional actionable defect found in shape/domain checks or versioned length-framed source fingerprint. Repeated named parameters retain per-occurrence correspondence.
limits: Finite original-source review and native lexical observations; no security lowering, authentication, execution authority, full native scanner equivalence or acceptance-criterion promotion.
